title: Battles reach an end: resolve, and an AI that presses home
summary: Skirmishes against the AI now end in about 20 minutes, on resolve or on bases, instead of grinding on past half an hour.
rationale: The rule players see is the resolve readout on the status line, so one legible still shows it in place. The change in pacing is a measurement, given as end times, kills and first contact over AI-vs-AI seeds 1-6 in the pull request, not as footage.
source_ref: 47194210 (merge of main into claude/pacing-victory-e2061b). Windowed off-screen render: --offscreen --host --team=0 --seed=3 --timescale=6 --perf=0 --screenshot --shot-at=330 at 1600x900; the top-left 1000x300 is kept (status line, order of battle, the FOB), JPEG quality 85.
